name: frozen
description: Frozen selection configuration and checkpoint. Current fitting code uses training only. Original test-access chronology is not independently established by available history; post-audit controls do not change this release.

feature_spec.notes: relative = L2-normalised embedding minus the mean of the four same-question candidates; vote = 5 consensus/parse features from parsed final answers

standardisation: all blocks standardised with train-only mean/std, stored in the bundle
tie_rule: smallest original candidate index among scores within 1e-9 of the maximum
